# Swastik Nursing Home
> Pediatric and orthopedic nursing home on L.B.S. Marg, opposite Shreyas Theatre, Ghatkopar West, Mumbai, since 2002. Phone 022 2500 8858. WhatsApp +91 98213 30087. Not an emergency facility (call 108).

## Clinic
- Name: Swastik Nursing Home (स्वस्तिक नर्सिंग होम)
- Address: C-101 / Room No. 101, 1st Floor, Bhaveshwar Plaza, L. B. S. Marg, opposite Shreyas Theatre, Ghatkopar West, Mumbai 400086, Maharashtra, India
- Coordinates: 19.08727, 72.90132
- Nearest station: Ghatkopar (Central line and Metro Line 1), under 1 km
- Phone: 022 2500 8858 (+91 22 2500 8858)
- WhatsApp: +91 98213 30087
- Hours: Monday to Friday 9:00 AM – 8:00 PM; Saturday 9:00 AM – 2:00 PM; Sunday closed
- Walk-ins seen during clinic hours; calling first is recommended
- Payment: cash and UPI
- Languages: English, Hindi, Marathi
- Website languages: English (https://www.swastiknursinghome.org/) and Hindi (https://www.swastiknursinghome.org/hi)

## Doctors
### Dr. Amit Shah — Pediatrician
- MBBS, MD (Pediatrics); 15+ years
- Consultation from ₹800
- Newborn and infant care, vaccination (IAP schedule), fever and infections, growth and nutrition, allergy and asthma
- https://www.swastiknursinghome.org/doctor/dr-amit-shah

### Dr. Swapnil Shah — Orthopedic Surgeon
- MBBS (Shivaji University, 1991), MS Orthopedics (Shivaji University, 1996); 27+ years
- Maharashtra Medical Council registration no. 070546
- Consultation from ₹1,000
- Knee, hip and shoulder pain, arthritis, fractures, back and neck pain, sports injuries, post-operative care
- https://www.swastiknursinghome.org/doctor/dr-swapnil-shah
